req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires that (1) every POST /tasks/ response carries a server-assigned integer id, (2) two successive creates receive distinct ids, and (3) any id field supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored. Tests cover: EP-positive (normal create, id is integer and positive), EP-positive (two creates yield distinct ids), NEG (client-supplied id is ignored), BVA (boundary-valid payload with max-length description still gets auto-id), NEG (invalid payload – empty title – yields 422, not 201). Each test asserts exact status codes and exact field types/values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title, description, completed=false
Inspect response status code and body
expected: Response body contains field 'id' that is an integer
Response body contains 'title' matching the submitted value
trace: R-TASK-030: system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "A", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id()

tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_two_consecutive_creates_receive_distinct_ids():
    p1 = {"title": "Task Alpha", "completed": False}
    p2 = {"title": "Task Beta", "completed": True}
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json=p1)
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json=p2)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id1 > 0
    assert id2 > 0
    assert id1 != id2
    assert id2 == id1 + 1

test_two_consecutive_creates_receive_distinct_ids()

os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_boundary_title_length_100_accepted_and_gets_auto_id():
    title_min = "A"
    title_max = "B" * 100
    r_min = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_min, "completed": False})
    r_max = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_max, "completed": True})
    assert r_min.status_code == 201
    assert r_max.status_code == 201
    id_min = r_min.json()["id"]
    id_max = r_max.json()["id"]

    assert isinstance(id_max, int) and id_max > 0
    assert id_min != id_max
    assert r_min.json()["title"] == title_min
    assert r_max.json()["title"] == title_max
